dependency_coverage.name: Asymptotics.IsEquivalent
dependency_coverage.meaning: For functions u and v along a filter l, u is asymptotically equivalent to v when u - v is little-o of v along l (with little-o interpreted using the norm on the codomain).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the conclusion the relative asymptotic statement that the difference between the Poisson mass and the displayed real-valued comparison term is negligible compared with that comparison term as k tends to infinity.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies ordinary real division for the quotient inside the kth power and for division by the square-root factor; it adds no separate proposition-level assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.atTop
dependency_coverage.meaning: The filter at infinity on a preorder, generated by the upper-tail sets {x | a <= x}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies that the asymptotic equivalence is taken as the natural-number index k tends to infinity, so changing finitely many initial values does not affect the claim.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The operation selected by a heterogeneous-division instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Realizes both displayed divisions as real-number division; it is notation/typeclass plumbing rather than an additional mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The operation selected by a heterogeneous-multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Realizes the products exp(1) times rate, exp(-rate) times the kth power, 2 times k, and that result times pi as ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The operation selected by a heterogeneous-power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the displayed base as a real number raised to the natural-number exponent k.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the sole hypothesis as strict positivity, 0 < rate, in the order on nonnegative reals.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds natural-number exponentiation in a monoid by repeated multiplication, with zeroth power equal to one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the standard real natural power ((e * rate) / k)^k appearing in the comparison term.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers equipped with a proof that they are nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts rate to be a nonnegative real before the additional hypothesis strengthens this to strict positivity.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal.toReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coercion/projection from a nonnegative real to its underlying real value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Uses the underlying real rate in exp(-rate) and in (e * rate / k)^k.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers 0, 1, 2, and so on.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the discrete index k of the Poisson mass function and of the asymptotic limit.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a type carrying a natural-number cast, here the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets k as a real number in the quotient (e * rate) / k and under sqrt(2 * k * pi).

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides a typeclass proof that a successor-form natural numeral is at least two when its predecessor is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports elaboration of the real numeral 2 and has no independent mathematical effect on the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides a proof that every successor natural number is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies internal evidence used to elaborate the numeral 2; it contributes no hypothesis or conclusion of its own.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard preorder on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Orders natural indices in the usual way for the atTop filter, so k tends through arbitrarily large natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unary negation operation selected by a Neg instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the real exponent -rate in exp(-rate).

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from a non-unital seminormed commutative ring to obtain a non-unital seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates only in the instance chain that presents the real numbers as a seminormed additive commutative group for asymptotic comparison.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the seminormed additive commutative group structure from a non-unital seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the norm and subtraction structure used by IsEquivalent on real-valued functions; it does not change the displayed formula.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets norm separation data from a normed commutative ring to obtain a seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is another structure-forgetting step used to supply the real seminormed additive group required by IsEquivalent.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a target type via its OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the literals 0, 1, and 2 in the relevant nonnegative-real, real, or natural types.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes exp(1) the real exponential at the real number one, namely the constant e.

dependency_coverage.name: PartialOrder.toPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets antisymmetry from a partial order to obtain its underlying preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in obtaining the strict order used by the positivity hypothesis on rate.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the strict-less-than relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the less-than operation in 0 < rate, with no additional condition beyond strict positivity.

dependency_coverage.name: ProbabilityTheory.poissonPMFReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: For nonnegative real parameter r and natural n, the real-valued Poisson probability mass exp(-r) * r^n / n!.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the left-hand function in the asymptotic equivalence: k maps to the Poisson mass at k for the fixed rate.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the codomain of both asymptotically compared functions and the number system in which the displayed exponential, products, quotient, power, pi, square root, subtraction, and norm are interpreted.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real exponential function x maps to e^x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms exp(-rate), and exp(1) supplies the constant e in the kth-power base.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative, inverse, and division structure on the real numbers, using the totalized convention inverse(0) = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the meaning of real division in (e * rate) / k and in the final quotient; in particular, the expression is total even at k = 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative monoid structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides real multiplication, one, and natural powers used in the comparison expression.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes every multiplication in the displayed comparison term ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes each occurrence of the natural index k in real arithmetic equal to its usual nonnegative real value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive negation operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets -rate as the additive inverse of the underlying real rate.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the argument 1 of exp(1), so that factor is the real constant e.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed commutative ring structure on the real numbers, whose norm is absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ultimately supplies the real norm, addition, and subtraction used in the little-o definition of asymptotic equivalence, as well as the ordinary ring operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pi
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant pi.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the normalizing denominator sqrt(2 * k * pi).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function (with its total real definition on all real inputs).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the denominator sqrt(2 * k * pi), which is the usual positive square root for every k > 0.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the multiplicative identity from a seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is an instance-chain step toward the seminormed additive commutative group required for real-valued asymptotic equivalence; it imposes no new mathematical restriction.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the nonnegative-real zero in the strict-positivity hypothesis 0 < rate.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous division operation on a type to the corresponding heterogeneous-division interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes both syntactic divisions to standard real division and adds no proposition-level content.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous multiplication operation on a type to the corresponding heterogeneous-multiplication interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes every displayed product to standard real multiplication and adds no proposition-level content.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a power operation to the corresponding heterogeneous-power interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the real base and natural exponent k to standard real natural-number exponentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an OfNat instance for a numeral at least two from a type's natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the displayed real numeral 2 as the natural-number cast of 2; it contributes no extra hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets every natural-number numeral as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the internal construction of the natural literals used while elaborating 0, 1, and 2, without changing the mathematical statement.

dependency_coverage.name: instPartialOrderNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard partial order on nonnegative reals inherited from the real-number order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures that 0 < rate means the underlying real value of rate is strictly positive.

dependency_coverage.name: instZeroNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The zero element of the nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the left endpoint zero in the positivity assumption on rate.

binders: rate is an arbitrary nonnegative real number.
conclusions: As k tends to infinity through the natural numbers, the real Poisson probability mass exp(-rate) * rate^k / k! is asymptotically equivalent to exp(-rate) * ((e * rate) / k)^k / sqrt(2 * k * pi).
Equivalently in the definition used here, the difference between those two real-valued functions of k is little-o of the displayed comparison function along the natural-number atTop filter.
mathematical_definitions: For a nonnegative real rate and natural k, poissonPMFReal(rate, k) = exp(-rate) * rate^k / k!.

exp(1) is the real constant e, every occurrence of k inside real arithmetic is the natural-to-real cast, powers have natural exponent k, pi is the usual real constant, and sqrt denotes the nonnegative real square root.
For real-valued functions u and v, IsEquivalent at atTop means u - v = o(v) as k tends to infinity.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every fixed positive real rate, viewed as a nonnegative real parameter, the Poisson probability at the natural value k is asymptotic as k tends to infinity to exp(-rate) times ((e times rate) divided by k) to the kth power, divided by the square root of 2 times k times pi.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The parameter rate is fixed before k tends to infinity; the statement is pointwise in rate and asserts no uniformity as rate varies.
The domain excludes rate = 0 and all negative rates by requiring a nonnegative-real parameter together with 0 < rate.
The limit is only along natural k tending to infinity, so the claim says nothing about a finite range of indices.

Real division is totalized at zero, so the displayed comparison function has a formal value at k = 0 even though both an inner and outer denominator vanish there; atTop asymptotics ignore this isolated initial value.
Asymptotic equivalence is encoded as u - v = o(v), not as an explicitly stated limit of u/v, and no error bound or convergence rate is asserted.
For positive rate the comparison term is strictly positive for every k >= 1, so the asymptotic assertion is not made vacuous by an eventually zero comparison function.
